criteria.description: the tool's options include "Reverse word order", off at first. With it on, the words of the text come out in reverse order and each word keeps its letters: "Hello big world" becomes "world big Hello".

with "Reverse word order" and "Process multi-line text" both on, the words of each line are reversed separately and the lines keep their order: "one two" on the first line and "three four" on the second become "two one" and "four three".
with "Reverse word order" off, the tool still reverses the characters: "Hello World" becomes "dlroW olleH".
